proposed.label: Account brief
proposed.proposed: The 2025 Asset Management Plan lists 354.7 km of paved roads but doesn't say this is centerline, so the Township's centerline kilometers still need confirming. The Township's Roads and Sidewalks page covers "the maintenance, repair and replacement of traffic signs," and its Asset Management Plan lists signs among the supporting assets it owns and manages. In this Ontario jurisdiction, O. Reg. 239/02, s. 12(1) requires regulatory and warning signs to be checked against Ontario Traffic Manual retroreflectivity requirements once per calendar year, no more than 16 months apart. Next step: confirm centerline kilometers with Mike DiPaola, Director, Infrastructure, by contacting Public Works at infrastructure@westlincoln.ca or 905-957-3346 ext. 5139.
